scope.flow: removeMargin withdrawal of initial margin while position has positive uPNL
scope.environment: perpetual futures protocol with margin, liquidation fee, insurance fund and backstop liquidators

statements.text: The position has high enough PnL (positive uPNL) such that the user can withdraw their initial margin via removeMargin.
The user calls removeMargin to withdraw their initial margin.
assertPostWithdrawalMarginRequired checks the total equity of the position rather than the margin alone, so the min-margin requirement is bypassable when PnL is high.
After a margin withdrawal, the position must still satisfy the minimum margin required for the user's current position; the check must not be bypassable by counting positive uPNL as margin.
When a position becomes liquidatable, the liquidation fee must be settled on the user's margin rather than avoided by the user.
In backstop liquidations, rewards for backstop liquidators must be paid rather than avoided.
the user avoids paying any fees to the protocol since the liquidaton fee is settled on the user margin but it would be zero
the entire negative pnl becomes the total bad debt that has to be covered entirely by the protocol's insurance fund
in case of backstop liquidations, not only the user avoids liquidation fees but also any rewards for the backstop liquidators

ambiguities: Report does not state who may call removeMargin or whether it is permissionless; only the position owner scenario is described.
Report does not give numeric thresholds for 'high enough pnl' or the minimum margin requirement.
Report does not establish a prior transaction/state showing the position already had margin withdrawn before liquidation; the liquidation scenario is conditional.
Report does not specify whether the withdrawal fully empties margin or leaves a nonzero remainder.
